# 北京市中小学人工智能教育地方课程纲要（试行）（2025年版）

Beijing Municipal Education Commission (北京市教育委员会), document 京教基二〔2025〕6号, issued and published 2025-06-26. Status: 现行有效 (currently in force). Full notice retrieved (attached outline is the full local curriculum standard).

## Key findings
- The Beijing Education Commission issued the **《北京市中小学人工智能教育地方课程纲要（试行）（2025年版）》** (Beijing Local Curriculum Outline for AI Education in Primary and Secondary Schools, Trial, 2025 edition) to promote high-quality implementation of AI education in the city's primary and secondary schools.
- **Legal basis** (per the notice):
  - 《教育部办公厅关于加强中小学人工智能教育的通知》(教基厅函〔2024〕32号) — MOE General Office notice on strengthening AI education in primary/secondary schools (the national circular, cf. source 93).
  - 《北京市推进中小学人工智能教育工作方案（2025—2027年）》(京教办〔2025〕2号) — Beijing's work plan for advancing AI education in primary/secondary schools (2025–2027).
- **Addressees**: district education commissions, Yanshan Education Commission, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area Social Affairs Bureau, and all directly-affiliated primary/secondary schools.
- The Commission instructs recipients to "seriously grasp implementation and application" (认真抓好贯彻落实). The notice is publicly released (此件公开发布).
- The attached document is the full local curriculum outline (试行/trial, 2025 edition) — Beijing's municipal-level implementation of the national AI-education policy.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — primary/official: the Beijing Municipal Education Commission's own published policy document (local curriculum standard).
